name: Create a databank
action: Open "+ New databank", type the name, Create — and wait until the new databank tab appears

params.name: name
params.description: Name for the new databank, as it should appear on its tab

verify.note: present, not visible: the databank tab strip lives in a drawer that is COLLAPSED by default, so the tab renders with zero size until the user opens it. The tab existing is still a real postcondition (one per databank); forcing the drawer would be worse, since dbk.header is a toggle with no state ref.

name: Rename a databank
action: Select the databank tab, open its TAB MENU, choose Rename, type the new name and confirm — then wait until the tab's TEXT shows the new name. Two things make this the only correct shape: the rename plugin's onClick(tab) returns immediately without tab context (so the toolbar button cannot drive it), and quantTabs renders the tab's data-testid through a ONE-TIME binding, so a rename changes the visible text but NEVER the testid — the tab keeps being addressed by its original name. NOTE: dbk.rename is a different control: it renames the SELECTED STRATEGIES.

params.name: databank
params.description: Databank to rename, as shown on its tab — required, the tab menu takes its context from the selected tab

verify.note: the ORIGINAL testid on purpose — it never changes; the new name shows up as the tab's text

name: Move a databank to a position

label.en: Move a databank to a position

action: Select the databank tab, open its tab menu, choose "Move to position", type the position and confirm. NOTE: the modal refs (dbk.move-modal.*) are shell-scoped and carry NO preconditions of their own — the tab menu is the only way in, which is why this flow exists (tests/ui/docs/NEEDS.md).

params.name: databank
params.description: Databank to move, as shown on its tab — omit to move the one currently selected

verifyTodo: Tab ORDER is not observable through any catalogued ref — a positional testid family (databank-tab-at-{index}) or a read ref over the tab strip would be needed.

name: Delete a databank
action: Select the databank tab, open its TAB MENU, choose Delete and accept the confirm — then wait until the tab is gone. The tab menu is the only way in: the plugin's onClick(tab) returns immediately without tab context, and the toolbar's dbk.delete is a different control that removes selected STRATEGIES. The app refuses the delete when the databank is still used by a task, so a failed verify can mean 'in use', not a broken flow.

params.name: databank
params.description: Databank to delete, as shown on its tab. After a rename pass the ORIGINAL name — the tab keeps its first data-testid.

verify.note: absent, not gone: the tab is removed from the DOM entirely; a zero-size tab in a collapsed drawer would satisfy 'gone' even if the delete never happened
